item.text:
**Assessment**
Sharif did mobilize the state effectively in several 2024 priority areas, especially macro stabilization, social delivery, power-sector discipline, and counterterrorism. The mobilization was real but uneven: highly PM-centered, partly technocratic, and frequently short on durable institutionalization. Coercive media/judicial controls helped protect the ruling environment, but they also underline that the network was mobilized as much for regime defense as for program execution.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Pakistan’s largest parties strike deal on coalition government](https://theprint.in/world/pakistans-largest-parties-strike-deal-on-coalition-government/1973213/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-21 | After a hung election, PML-N and PPP struck a governing deal rather than collapsing into stalemate. This is direct evidence that Sharif could mobilize a coalition around taking office and governing. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`
- [PM Shehbaz directs PPP and PML-N to resolve budget differences through dialogue](https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1840944) | Dawn | 2024-06-21 | Coalition budget tensions were handled through dialogue and a continuing committee, showing ongoing bargaining capacity inside the ruling bloc rather than immediate coalition breakdown. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`
- [Pakistan PM Sharif picks prominent banker in new cabinet, document shows](https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-sharif-picks-prominent-banker-in-new-cabinet-document-shows/1996146/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | Sharif brought banker Muhammad Aurangzeb into the finance portfolio, signaling technocratic staffing for the stabilization program. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [PM forms economic advisory council for policy guidance](https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1190715-pm-forms-new-economic-advisory-council-without-dar-aurangzeb) | The News | 2024-05-19 | Sharif created a high-powered advisory council with economists, technocrats, and business figures. That is a concrete attempt to mobilize expertise behind the program. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [PM declares Education Emergency to enroll 26 million out-of-school children](https://www.radio.gov.pk/08-05-2024/pm-declares-education-emergency-to-enroll-26-million-out-of-school-children) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-05-08 | Sharif set a numeric target, said he would personally supervise the effort, and tied it to provincial coordination and incentives. This shows direct executive mobilization around a flagship priority. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [Pakistan IMF reaches agreement on economic policies for 37-month EFF](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/12/pr-24273-pakistan-imf-reaches-agreement-on-economic-policies-for-37-month-eff) | IMF | 2024-07-12 | The program linked the FY25 budget to expanded BISP, education, and health spending, plus a National Fiscal Pact shifting more social spending to provinces. This is strong evidence of a program translated into bureaucratic and fiscal machinery. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [PM directs to minimize load-shedding](https://www.radio.gov.pk/28-05-2024/shehbaz-sharif-directs-to-minimize-load-shedding) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-05-28 | Sharif ordered an anti-power-theft campaign, monthly review, task forces at provincial and divisional levels, and expert hiring for DISCO privatization. That is concrete enforcement machinery, not just rhetoric. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [All state-owned enterprises to be privatised: PM](https://www.dawn.com/news/1833439/all-state-owned-enterprises-to-be-privatised-pm) | Dawn | 2024-05-15 | Sharif said non-strategic SOEs would be privatized, ministries were told to cooperate, and power utilities were folded into a 2024-29 privatization program. This shows a clear effort to align the bureaucracy behind a defined economic program. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [PM for collective efforts to eliminate menace of terrorism](https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-06-22 | Sharif launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and explicit resource support for the armed forces. This shows effective mobilization of the military and provinces toward a concrete security goal. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [BISP full digitalization of social welfare payments](https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/) | APP | 2024-03-18 | Sharif ordered BISP payments onto digital wallets to reduce leakage, delay, and discretion. This is a concrete delivery reform that mobilizes the state into rule-based implementation. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [PM relieves finance minister from key economic forum](https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967/pm-shehbaz-relieves-finance-minister-from-key-economic-forum) | Dawn | 2024-06-15 | Sharif took personal control of ECNEC rather than fully delegating to the technocrat finance minister. This shows strong central command, but also that mobilization remained personalized rather than institutionally delegated. | `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [Cabinet still leaned heavily on old political hands](https://www.dawn.com/news/1821157) | Dawn | 2024-03-01 | The cabinet composition remained dominated by established political figures, weakening the case for a clean technocratic break. That limits how far one can say Sharif mobilized a fresh programmatic team. | `8B.3`, `8B.1`
- [Government clamps down on dissenting media, opposition, and NGOs](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | HRW said pressure on media and critics deepened self-censorship and fear. This is negative evidence that the ruling network also mobilized coercively to protect itself, not only to execute the program. | `8B.3`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`
- [Pakistan’s interior ministry says X was blocked on national-security grounds](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-17 | The state blocked X during the election period, restricting criticism and monitoring at a politically sensitive moment. That shows the apparatus being used for regime defense and information control. | `8B.3`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`
- [Pakistan’s government curbs judiciary’s power after alleged harassment of MPs](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps) | The Guardian | 2024-10-21 | Critics said the 26th Amendment weakened judicial independence amid intimidation allegations. That is strong counterevidence to a claim of durable, neutral institutional mobilization. | `8B.3`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find a single authoritative 2024 source that maps Sharif’s whole ruling network end-to-end.
- The evidence is fragmented across IMF program documents, Radio Pakistan announcements, cabinet reporting, and rights reporting.
- There is also little direct proof of disciplined party machinery beyond coalition bargaining and cabinet formation.
- The best-supported reading is that Sharif mobilized the state effectively in select domains, but the mobilization was PM-centered and uneven, not a fully consolidated governing machine.
